posts.t: Can I record the microphone AND the speakers ?

posts.h:
the only way possible to record both speakers and mic sound (in win7) is to go to the microphone options and under the 'Listen' tab to select the 'Listen to this device' option.
It's a workaround, rather than a feature, but since the program itself doesn't support it yet
